lines.text: Paul says to pursue love and desire spiritual gifts, especially prophecy, which edifies the church.
Paul says unclear sounds from a flute, harp or trumpet help no one, so gifts should build up the church.
Paul will pray and sing with spirit and mind, since an uninstructed listener cannot say Hallelujah to an unknown blessing.
In church Paul would rather speak seven coherent words to instruct than ten thousand in a tongue.
Paul says an unbeliever who hears everyone prophesying will fall facedown and worship God, saying God is truly among you.
